gaps.sentence: He talks as if he ___ the owner of the place.
gaps.explanation: 'As if he were' — subjunctive for an unreal comparison.

gaps.sentence: I'd better not ___ you — you look busy.
I'd like to know when the results ___ be published.
gaps.explanation: Future in a noun clause: when the results will be published.

gaps.sentence: The fire is believed ___ by faulty wiring.
gaps.explanation: 'believed to have been + participle' — the cause was earlier.

gaps.sentence: The first edition of the book ___ out in 1998.
The project ran ___ of money halfway through.
gaps.explanation: 'Run out of' = use up the supply.

gaps.sentence: She ___ the door quietly behind her.
He walked in as ___ nothing had happened.
